Former Chief Election Commissioner Rajiv Kumar Appointed HDFC Chairman

Former Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Rajiv Kumar has been appointed as the part-time Chairman of HDFC Bank. His appointment follows the resignation of Atanu Chakraborty and is for a four-year term. Kumar is known for his background in banking reforms and for overseeing the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
